api_token.description: Deprecated: replaced by the 'Hugging Face token' field. Connections configured before 0.1.0 keep working through this field.
api_token.title: Hugging Face API token (deprecated)

dataset_name.description: The dataset identifier on the Hugging Face Hub, for example 'nyu-mll/glue'. See the dataset page URL at https://huggingface.co/datasets.
dataset_name.title: Dataset name

dataset_splits.description: Splits to sync, for example 'train'. All of them are synced if nothing is provided. See https://huggingface.co/docs/dataset-viewer/en/configs_and_splits#splits.
dataset_splits.title: Dataset splits

dataset_subsets.description: Subsets (configs) to sync. All of them are synced if nothing is provided. See https://huggingface.co/docs/dataset-viewer/en/configs_and_splits#configs.
dataset_subsets.title: Dataset subsets

streaming.description: When enabled, records are read from the Hub on the fly instead of being downloaded and cached to disk. Slower, but it handles datasets larger than the available disk. See https://huggingface.co/docs/datasets/stream.
streaming.title: Streaming mode

token.description: Hugging Face token, used to read private or gated datasets and to raise the anonymous rate limits. Optional for public datasets. Create one at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens.
token.title: Hugging Face token
